Outdoor Recreation
On page 1-14 of the subject document, reference is made to the Appalachian Foothills Trail. The trail described in the statement and pertinent to applicant's proposed trail is referred to as the Cherokee Foothills Trail, the Carolina Foothills Trail, or the Foothills Trail. To our knowledge, it has never been called the Appalachian Foothills Trail except in the draft impact statement. To the extent that the nomenclature is not widely used, it may be misleading to readers not familiar with the route description.
Section 1.4.1 has been revised to reflect the prevalent nomenclature.
In comparing recreation potential at the alternative pumped storage sites, the references to a numerical order of recreation potential is misleading and uninformative unless the basis of the ranking system is also discussed. If the ordering is used to describe recreation aspects of the alternative sites, it should be accompanied with discussion of the system and specific references to recreation related data and social data for the sites. If the system is not used, the Recreation sections can be improved with greater reference to specific recreation related data for the sites.
Sections 8.3.1.5, 8.3.2.5, and 8.3.3.5 have been revised.

4.2.3. History and Archeology
This section is not supported by data included in the statement. On page 2-71 (2.5.2) it is noted that the route of the proposed transmission line was not surveyed for cultural resources. The section should be rewritten to conform to actual knowledge based on field surveys.
This section has been revised. Applicant has proposed archeological surveys for the transmission line corridor.
